items.title: Ida Goodson Interview, 1961-05-06
items.q: I know what Dee Dee does... I know Dee Dee, I'm not talking about him, I'm talking to you.

ctx.x: . . . . . I know what Dee Dee does, Billy, but you understand all that French now? I know Dee Dee, I'm not talking about him, I'm talking to you. I know what he be talking about all right. And if somebody don't say it I don't like, I know what to do. I know exactly what to do. That's a Dee Dee. You're straight here, man. Who, well, you know that. Oh, that was good. I'm glad you didn't have one of y'all do the last one, that was the best one. Well, no, the last one is always the best. Yeah, that's right. Yes, sir.…
